app.name: ShilpIchiba
app.tagline: ଶିଳ୍ପ, ଏବଂ ସେହି ବଜାର ଯେଉଁଠାରେ କୌଣସି କାରଣରେ ପହଞ୍ଚିପାରିଲା ନାହିଁ
common.offline: ଇଣ୍ଟରନେଟ ନାହିଁ — ଆପଣଙ୍କର କାମ ଏହି ଫୋନରେ ସୁରକ୍ଷିତ ରହିଛି
onb.whyMoney: ବିକ୍ରିରୁ ମିଳିଥିବା ଟଙ୍କା ସିଧା ଆପଣଙ୍କ ଖାତାରେ ପହଞ୍ଚେ
onb.whyProof: ଆପଣଙ୍କର ପ୍ରାମାଣିକତା ପ୍ରମାଣପତ୍ର ଆପଣଙ୍କ ନାମରେ ଜାରି ହୋଇଛି
onb.whyGroup: You can join group orders with your cluster
onb.createAccountSub: With your phone number, in a minute
onb.skip: Not now — start without an account
onb.skipSub: You can create one later; nothing will be lost
onb.guestNote: Without an account you can still take photos, write details and set a price. An account is only needed to publish, and your work stays exactly as it is.
onb.spoken: You can prepare a whole listing without an account. An account is only needed when you want to sell.
home.emptySub: ଉପରେର ବଟନ ଦବାନ୍ତୁ ଏବଂ ଆପଣଙ୍କ ପ୍ରଥମ ପଦାର୍ଥ ଯୋଡନ୍ତୁ
home.help: କିଛି ବୁଝିଲା ନାହିଁ? ଏଠା ଦବାନ୍ତୁ, ଆପ୍ପ କହିବାକୁ ପାରିବ।
home.helpSpoken: ପଦାର୍ଥ ଯୋଡିବାକୁ ବଡ଼ କମଳା ବଟନ ଦବାନ୍ତୁ। ପରେ ଫୋଟୋ ନିଅନ୍ତୁ ଏବଂ ଆପଣଙ୍କ ଭାଷାରେ କହନ୍ତୁ।
home.trendSub: ତାନ୍ତି ଲଗାଇବା ପୂର୍ବରୁ କଣ କିଣିବାକୁ ଚାହୁଁଛି ସେତେ ଜାଣନ୍ତୁ
create.title: ନୂତନ ପଦାର୍ଥ
create.subtitle: ସବୁ ଏକଠାରେ
create.takePhotoHint: ଯଦି ଲେବେଲ୍ କିମ୍ବା ମୂଲ୍ୟ ଟାଗ ଦେଖାଯାଏ ତେବେ ସେ ସ୍ୱୟଂଚାଳିତ ପଢ଼ିବ
create.craftHint: ଏହାଦ୍ୱାରା କ୍ୟାମେରା ଠିକ ପରାମର୍ଶ ଦେବ — ପ୍ରତି କଳାର ଅନ୍ୟତମ ଆବଶ୍ୟକତା ଅଛି
create.ocrNone: ଫୋଟୋରେ କୌଣସି ଲେଖା ମିଳିଲା ନାହିଁ — ଆପଣ ନାମ ଏବଂ ମୂଲ୍ୟ ସ୍ୱୟଂ ଭରିପାରିବେ, କିମ୍ବା ଉଚ୍ଚ ସ୍ବରରେ କହିପାରିବେ।
create.analysing: ଚିହ୍ନିତ କରୁଛି… OCR, ବସ୍ତୁ ଏବଂ ପରିବେଶ
create.floorNote: କାଚା ମାଲ ଏବଂ ଆପଣଙ୍କର ଶ୍ରମ। ଏହାରୁ କମରେ ବିକ୍ରି ହେଲେ ହାନି।
create.breakdownEmpty: ଉପରେ "ଉଚିତ ମୂଲ୍ୟ ବାହାର କରନ୍ତୁ" ଦବାନ୍ତୁ, କିମ୍ବା ତଳେ ସ୍ବୟଂ ଲାଇନ ଯୋଗ ଦିଅନ୍ତୁ।
create.mismatch: ଲାଇନଗୁଡ଼ିକ ଯୋଗ {sum}, କିନ୍ତୁ ମୂଲ୍ୟ {price} ଦେଖାଯାଉଛି — ଅନ୍ତର {diff}।
create.mismatchNote: ଆପଣ ଚାହିଲେ ଭିନ୍ନ ରଖିପାରିବେ। ମିଳାଇବାକୁ ଚାହୁଛନ୍ତି କି ତଳେ ସ୍ପର୍ଶ କରନ୍ତୁ।
create.explainPlaceholder: ଉଦାହରଣ: ଅସଲି ଜାରି, ତିନି ଦିନ ଲାଗିଲା
create.channelsTitle: Where do you want to sell?
create.channelsNote: One tap sends it everywhere. Each marketplace wants a different format — the app converts it for you.
create.notConfiguredNote: Some chosen channels are not set up yet. The app will still try, and show you the real result — it will never show a false success.
create.loginNeededBanner: You will need an account when you send — your work will be kept.
create.noOrders: No orders yet. When someone buys from the link above, it will appear here on its own.
cam.permBody: The app needs the camera to photograph your product. The photo is checked on your phone itself.
cam.fixFirst: Fix what is written above — you can still take it
guide.empty: Place the product inside the frame
guide.dark: Too dark — move to a brighter place
guide.glare: Too much glare — turn away from the direct light
guide.blur: The photo is blurry — hold the phone still
guide.close: Move back — the whole product does not fit
guide.offcentre: Bring the product to the centre
guide.clutter: Clear the background, or put a plain cloth behind
shot.pottery.full: The whole piece, from the front
shot.general.label: Label or price tag
shot.nextReason: The main photo is done. Now take {what}.
auth.workSafe: Your work is safe — nothing will be lost
auth.whyPhone: Buyers and the courier will call this number about your order.
auth.smsNotSetUp: SMS is not set up — test code
auth.devEchoNote: This is only visible because OTP_DEV_ECHO is on.
auth.nameNote: This name is printed on the invoice and the courier label.
auth.pickupNote: The courier collects from here, so the address must be complete and correct.
auth.sameReturn: Use this as the return address too
auth.needForChannels: The marketplaces you chose need this information:
auth.skipExtra: Skip for now — sell on my own page only
auth.allReadySub: You can now send your product to the marketplaces.
auth.workKept: Your earlier work is safe ({n} draft(s))
auth.loginToPublish: You need an account to send your product to a marketplace. Your name, number and address are needed for the buyer, the courier and the payment. Everything you have done so far will be kept exactly as it is.
auth.needMore: The marketplaces you chose need a little more information. Only what is genuinely required will be asked.
prod.title: My Products
prod.emptySub: Products you create will appear here
ord.title: Orders
ord.emptySub: When someone buys your product, the order will appear here
ord.needsLogin: Sign in to see your orders
prof.title: Profile
prof.notSignedInSub: Sign in to save your details and sell
prof.serverNote: The phone and the computer must be on the same Wi-Fi. Even without a server, the camera, photo checks and drafts keep working.
prof.offlineFraming: Finding the product in the frame
prof.onlineNote: Publishing, signing in and payment need the internet.
prof.languageNote: This language is used for reading, speaking and listening.
sync.offlineBody: Showing what was saved on this phone. Your work is safe and will be sent when the connection comes back.
sync.conflictTitle: This was changed somewhere else too
sync.conflictBody: While your phone was offline, {field} was also changed on the server. We kept the server value so nothing was silently thrown away.
sort.label: Sort
filter.label: Show
pd.title: Product
pd.priceBreakdown: How this price was worked out
pd.notListed: This product has not been sent to any marketplace yet.
mp.title: On {name}
mp.noBuyerData: {name} does not share buyer details through its API, so there is nothing to show here.
home.needsYouNone: Nothing needs your attention right now.
home.viewsNote: Counted on your own storefront page. Other marketplaces do not share view counts.
home.guestBanner: You are using the app without an account
home.guestBannerSub: Your drafts are saved on this phone. Sign in to send them to a marketplace and to keep them if you change phones.
ins.title: What other artisans are doing
ins.sub: From products other sellers have actually published here.
ins.hidden: Hidden. You can turn it back on in Profile.
ins.show: Show what other artisans are doing
ins.notEnough: Not enough sellers have published in your craft yet to show this safely. It will appear once there are more.
ins.privacy: These are combined figures. No individual seller, price or income is shown, and a craft is left out entirely unless at least {n} different sellers have published in it.
enq.title: Bulk and custom orders
enq.sub: Customers who want many pieces, or something made specially.
enq.explain: When somebody opens your product page they can ask for a larger quantity or a custom variation. Those requests arrive here.
enq.emptySub: Once your products are live, buyers wanting a large or custom order can send you a request from the product page.
enq.replyPlaceholder: Your price and how long it will take
prof.showInsights: Show what other artisans are doing
prof.storageNote: Your language, sign-in and drafts stay on this phone so the app opens straight away and works without internet.
prof.clearCacheNote: Removes the offline copies only. Nothing on the server is deleted.
